description: `start multiverse`, with `[projects.multiverse]` omitting `path`, opens exactly one workspace for the hub (decided changes 1a-1c, `20261108-b-81cb2b`, revised by the home-board-tab builder brief): `workspace create` labeled `multiverse` rooted at `<state dir>/home` (created since it did not exist — a missing hub home is created, never refused, unlike an ordinary project's missing path), the home seed written there, and a create-if-absent, unfocused `board` tab (`tab list`, `tab create --label board --no-focus`) running the one-shot `board --all --read-only` (no `--watch`) in its root pane (`pane run`). No account is configured, so no Nexus launches into the root pane. The strict scripted transcript below is exhaustive: no `pane split` call is scripted, so the hub falling back to the old split-pane board (it must not, ever again) would fail this scenario rather than merely going unchecked. Exit EXIT_OK (0).
